name: Buddles
title: Local Street Bookmaker & Pawn Shark
description: Neighborhood corner bookie operating out of a tobacco kiosk. Friendly demeanor until your note matures.
enforcementLore: Dispatches two baseball-bat wielding street cousins to shake down delinquent borrowers. Prefers taking watches and sneakers over hospitalization.
warningQuote: Hey pal, I gotta eat too. Pay on time and we stay friends. Let it slide, and my cousins come knocking.

name: Strange-ear Leonard
title: Back-Alley Fencing Banker
description: Twitchy dockside financier with an ear cut off in a 1989 port brawl. Has an unmatched nose for liquid contraband collateral.
enforcementLore: Employs stevedores and cargo loaders who corner debtors inside shipping containers. If you fall behind, your warehouse stash is immediately tapped.
warningQuote: I don't hear so good out of my left side, but my muscle hears loud and clear when the envelope is short.

name: One-eyed Wilbur
title: Underground Chop-Shop Shylock
description: Cynical predatory moneylender who lost an eye to ricocheting lead. Fronts six-figure bankrolls for rapid, high-margin smuggling runs.
enforcementLore: Commands armed recovery tow-trucks that intercept and tow your private aircraft or impound your vehicle fleet off the tarmac.
warningQuote: Money has wheels in this city. If yours isn't rolling back to me by day eight, my boys start dismantling your fleet for scrap.

name: Odd Lenny
title: Cartel Sub-Prime Liquidity Enforcer
description: Erratic border financier with erratic mood swings and cartel backing. Demands ruthless compound interest calculated to the second.
enforcementLore: Back-stopped by militarized border sicarios armed with automatic rifles. Delinquency results in direct hit squad shootouts in broad daylight.
warningQuote: You think 40% a day is steep? Try breathing through a collapsed trachea. The clock is ticking, socio.

name: Laughing Max
title: Psychopathic Shadow Escrow Kingpin
turf: West Berlin Bunkers & Geneva Safe Depots
description: Chirpy European psychopath who chuckles hysterically while reviewing collection ledgers. Lends up to 3x liquid capital at lethal interest.
enforcementLore: Contracts former Stasi and Eastern bloc mercenaries equipped with plastic explosives and acid vats. Zero tolerance for late payments.
warningQuote: Hahaha! Oh, the sheer joy of compounding interest! Five days, mein freund, or my contractors turn your safehouse into a crater! Hahaha!

name: Don Salvatore 'The Icebox' Marcone
title: Cosa Nostra Caporegime & Shadow Banker
turf: Little Italy & Wall Street Vaults, NYC
description: Old-world Sicilian Don who finances high-stakes underworld acquisitions from a mahogany-paneled Mulberry Street social club.
enforcementLore: Commands made men and button men who quietly liquidate your safehouses, repossess your commercial shell entities, and arrange concrete overcoats.
warningQuote: In our family, a debt is a sacred vow before God. If you break that vow, you don't just owe me cash—you owe me your soul.

name: Sergei 'The Butcher' Voronov
title: Bratva Vor v Zakone & Oligarch Shadow Shylock
description: Ex-Soviet Spetsnaz officer turned Russian Mafia Vor. Controls millions in offshore black money laundered through oil and steel trusts.
enforcementLore: Dispatches heavily armed Spetsnaz veterans with titanium crowbars and anti-materiel rifles. Will execute simultaneous raids across all your safehouses.
warningQuote: In Russia, we have saying: 'Gold speaks, blood pays.' You take Sergei's rubles, you return Sergei's rubles, or we amputate your empire piece by piece.

name: Dragon Head Uncle Chen
title: 14K Triad High Councillor & VIP Junket Lender
turf: Kowloon Walled District & Wanchai, Hong Kong
description: Ruthless octogenarian Triad Dragon Head controlling billion-dollar underground casino liquidity pools across the Golden Triangle.
enforcementLore: Mobilizes hundreds of Red Pole triad enforcers wielding meat cleavers and machetes. Defaults trigger universal underworld death marks across all Asian ports.
warningQuote: The dragon gives generously to those who show respect. But if you dishonor the 14K, no corner of the earth will hide you from our blades.
